build:
bash -c 'ASM_JAR=$(find ~/.m2/repository/org/ow2/asm/asm/9.8 -name asm-9.8.jar | head -1); printf "Premain-Class: com.powsybl.fuzzing.agent.RegexBacktrackAgent
Can-Retransform-Classes: true
Boot-Class-Path: regex-agent.jar %s
" "$ASM_JAR" > target/agent-build/MANIFEST.MF'
jar cfm regex-agent.jar target/agent-build/MANIFEST.MF -C target/test-classes com/powsybl/fuzzing/agent -C target/test-classes com/powsybl/fuzzing/counter
classpath_command: bash -c 'echo -n target/test-classes; for j in lib/*.jar; do echo -n :$j; done; echo -n :; mvn -q dependency:build-classpath -DincludeScope=test -Dmdep.outputFile=/dev/stdout 2>/dev/null'
